description: In inbound.rs build_signed_string(), the 'digest' header arm only validates the Digest header if it is present (provided is empty check). If a remote sends a Signature with headers='(request-target) host date digest' but omits the Digest header entirely, the server builds the signed string using the computed digest — so the sender never had to commit to a body hash. An attacker who can replay a signed request can swap the body without invalidating the signature, provided they omit the Digest header.
title: HTTP sig verification skips digest when header absent
